earliest_visible_sign.description: Tiny pinpoint brown, tan, or dark moist-looking spots. Early lesions can be translucent when the leaf is held against light.

characteristic_sign_or_lesion.description: Long, narrow, sharply rectangular lesions running parallel to the leaf veins.

colors.color_progression: translucent to grey, tan, or brown

shape.shape_progression: pinpoint to long narrow rectangle to irregular after coalescence

size.size_variation_note: Substantial variation among host genotypes and pathogen populations.

advanced_or_severe_stage.description: Lesions merge into large grey-brown blotches and whole leaves blight.
advanced_or_severe_stage.coalescence: Lesions merge into large grey-brown blotches, becoming irregular.
advanced_or_severe_stage.tissue_death_appearance: Large areas of leaf tissue become necrotic; whole leaves may blight, dry, and die prematurely.
advanced_or_severe_stage.percentage_affected_tissue_note: Destroys increasing areas of leaf tissue, leading to reduced photosynthesis.

distribution_on_plant.vertical_pattern: Typically begins on lower leaves before or around flowering and progresses upward
distribution_on_plant.horizontal_pattern: Running parallel to the leaf veins, limited by adjacent secondary and tertiary veins
distribution_on_plant.other_parts_if_severe: Leaf sheath in severe infection; stalk indirectly through weakening and lodging

pathognomonic_features: Long, narrow, sharply rectangular grey-to-tan lesions running parallel to leaf veins, limited by secondary and tertiary veins.
Dark fungal sporulation points on mature opaque lesions.
